title: The Florida Aquarium in Tampa General Admission
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Strollers and wheelchairs are available at the Guest Services counter for an additional fee; quantities are limited.
policies: Parking options include a City of Tampa lot located 1 block north of The Florida Aquarium on Channelside Drive. Additional parking lots and garages are within walking distance of the Aquarium.

Please note: your ticket is active for up to 48 hours after your originally purchased date and time of visit as long as your original ticket is valid (has not been used and Aquarium barcode has not been scanned).
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Rated among the best aquariums in the US, The Florida Aquarium invites guests to explore more with 11 vibrant habitats that house dwarf seahorses, a giant Pacific octopus, and many wonderful creatures in between.

Three interactive habitats, including The Tide Pool, bring guests closer than ever to moon jellies, stingrays, sea stars, and more. While premium add-on experiences like the Wild Dolphin Cruise, Penguin Encounter, and SeaTREK underwater walking tour create unforgettable moments.

A must-see attraction in downtown Tampa, the Aquarium is dedicated to its shared purpose of saving marine wildlife. The Aquarium is accredited by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums for maintaining high standards in animal welfare, veterinary care, conservation, and education, among other requirements.
